A '''temple''' was located in the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]],<ref name="Topps" /> which was part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Bakura sector/Legends|Bakura sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and contained eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the lush terrestrial world [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kurtzen]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the temple had been reduced to ancient ruins. The [[Stone/Legends|stone]] structure included a staircase, columns, and other examples of masonry.<ref name="Topps" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: 4-LOM|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/112359/cid/7727291}} and {{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: Zuckuss|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/112359/cid/7727294}} are set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the events of {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Empire hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]]<ref name="Topps" />&mdash;a [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|droid]] and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] respectively<ref name="Gamer6">{{GamerCite|6|How the Other Half Hunts}}</ref>&mdash;to investigate the temple in order to find any lost relics or [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] that could be of use against the Alliance.<ref name="Topps" />

==Behind the scenes==
The temple was introduced on two cards of [[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|2015 Topps ''Star Wars'' Illustrated: ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], a [[Topps]] trading card set<ref name="Topps" /> released on [[April 29]], [[2015]].<ref name="Facebook 4/29">{{Facebook|username=OfficialToppsStarWars|url=OfficialToppsStarWars/photos/a.305898082871093.1073741825.274996949294540/701814056612825|name=[[Topps]] Star Wars|date=2015-04-29|quote=Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back trading cards are out in Hobby shops now!|archivefile=File:ToppsSWIESB.png}}</ref> The cards were illustrated by [[Grant Gould]].<ref name="Topps" />
